quote: Shadows will always follow you in the dark. Nobody can rescue you from your mind. You have to sit with the pain. You have to watch the memories fade. It is the only way to heal. You are here to survive your own ghosts. And when the quiet finally overtakes you, remind yourself you survived the night.
